stories.title: İstanbul'daki kazada ortalık savaş alanına döndü

en.title: Scene turned into a war zone in Istanbul accident
en.summary: A collision between two cars in Istanbul's Maltepe district injured 11 people. Rescue teams extracted trapped passengers from the vehicles.

stories.title: Beşiktaş'ta seyir halindeki hafif ticari araç alev alev yandı

en.title: Moving light commercial vehicle caught fire in Beşiktaş
en.summary: A light commercial vehicle caught fire while in motion in Beşiktaş. Fire crews extinguished the blaze and the vehicle was rendered unusable.

stories.title: Fed faizi yükseltti, Trump küplere bindi

en.title: Fed raises rates, Trump furious
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased interest rates by 25 basis points. Trump responded with criticism about U.S. interest rates following the decision.

stories.title: Çalışmak istemeyenin yardımı kesilecek… Sosyal yardımlara yeni düzenleme

en.title: Social aid will be cut for those unwilling to work... New regulation on social assistance
en.summary: A new social aid policy will require able-bodied recipients aged 18-54 to register with employment services or face aid suspension. Those refusing job offers or referrals will lose benefits for one year.

en.title: Not Wolves Valley but Jackals Valley
en.summary: A prosecutor's office opened an investigation into alleged FETÖ connections related to the TV series "Kurtlar Vadisi Pusu."

en.title: Taking Another Slice from AOÇ
en.summary: An institution founded by Atatürk continues to be built over with concrete, with a new Family and Social Services Ministry building planned on its grounds.

stories.title: Gazeteci Oya Lale Arslan tecritte tutuluyor

en.title: Journalist Oya Lale Arslan Held in Solitary Confinement
en.summary: Journalist Oya Lale Özan Arslan has been detained for 12 days with limited phone access of 10 minutes per week.

stories.title: Boşandığı eşini öldürdü, oğlunu yaraladı, intihar etti

en.title: Man Killed Estranged Wife, Wounded Son, Then Took His Own Life
en.summary: In Adana's Ceyhan district, a 49-year-old man fatally shot his estranged 52-year-old wife before wounding his son and taking his own life.

stories.title: Büşra bebeğin annesi ve babası tutuklandı

en.title: Büşra baby's mother and father arrested
en.summary: The parents of 11-month-old Büşra Balıkçı, who went missing in Divriği, Sivas six days ago, were detained during an investigation and subsequently remanded into custody by a court.

stories.title: Kaybolan Elif bebeğin annesi ve babası tutuklandı

en.title: Parents of Missing Baby Elif Arrested
en.summary: The mother and father of 11-month-old Büşra, who disappeared in Divriği district of Sivas, have been arrested among nine suspects detained in the investigation.

stories.title: Önce ‘sattı’ sonra ‘öldürdü’ dedi… 11 aylık bebek, 6 gündür aranıyor: Büşra bebeğin annesi ve babası tutuklandı

en.title: Parents of 11-Month-Old Büşra Arrested; Baby Missing for 6 Days
en.summary: The parents of 11-month-old Büşra Balıkçı, who went missing in Sivas six days ago, have been arrested along with eight other suspects in connection with the case.

stories.title: Emekli uzman çavuş, boşandığı eşini ve 13 yaşındaki oğlunu silahla vurup intihar etti

en.title: Retired warrant officer shoots ex-wife and 13-year-old son, then commits suicide
en.summary: A retired warrant officer in Ceyhan, Adana shot his ex-wife and 13-year-old son with a pistol before taking his own life. The ex-wife and officer died while the child was hospitalized with serious injuries.

stories.title: Ticaret Bakanlığı duyurdu: Güvensiz peluş anahtarlıklar toplatılıyor

en.title: Trade Ministry announces: Unsafe plush keychains being recalled
en.summary: The Trade Ministry identified safety violations in plush keychains intended for children use, including excessive chemical and nickel emissions and choking hazards. The product has been banned from sale and existing stock is being withdrawn from the market.

stories.title: Sofranın ötesinde köklü bir mirasa sahip çıkılıyor

en.title: A deep-rooted legacy beyond the table is being preserved
en.summary: Bursa, as the Ottomans' first capital, developed a distinctive food culture where palace, charitable kitchen, and merchant cuisines coexisted. The city's centuries-old culinary heritage is being protected through various cultural events.

en.title: International 5th Bursa Gastronomy Festival coming
en.summary: Bursa Metropolitan Municipality will host the International 5th Bursa Gastronomy Festival on September 18-20 at Merinos Park, themed "Flavors of Conquest", to promote the city's rich culinary culture internationally.

stories.title: Topraktan sofraya, yeni değer zincirinde lokomotif rol oynuyor

en.title: Playing locomotive role in new value chain, from farm to table
en.summary: Referans Holding's general manager stated that the farm-to-table approach guides gastronomy, and the company's integrated structure connecting agricultural sources with production and catering operations provides supply chain control, traceability, and cost management advantages.

stories.title: “Bursa, gastronomide elindeki büyük değeri doğru yönetmeli”

en.title: Bursa must properly manage its significant gastronomic value
en.summary: The head of a gastronomy association states that Bursa has not sufficiently converted its culinary and tourism assets into economic gains, arguing the city needs better management of existing strengths rather than creating new value.
